messages:
Asha: Quick recap from today's interview with NebulaGrid. Deliverables before we go live: signed release, one short pull quote for homepage, two tweet-length lines, and a speaker for a customer webinar. Goal: go live next Tue. Recording + notes: https://drive.google.com/nebulagrid-interview :rocket:

Matt: Nice. Do we have permission to use the metric they mentioned ("reduced inference cost by half")? They used a competitor name in the call.

Diego (CS): They did say "half the cost vs our old setup (on-prem GPU farm)". Customer prefers we not name the prior vendor. They asked for anonymized baseline.

Lina (Legal): We need a signed release that covers quotes, logos, and use in a webinar. I uploaded the template and a quick redline for the speaker release: https://drive.google.com/open?id=nebula-release-redline. Section 3 requires explicit metric confirmation if a vendor is named.

Asha: Understood. Can Marketing proceed with an anonymized metric like "~2x" or "50% lower inference cost"? Which is safer?

Lina (Legal): "~2x" or "about 50% lower" are both fine if the customer confirms. If we use precise phrasing we should attach the spreadsheet they used to derive the number. Otherwise use approximation.

Matt: I'll draft two quote options and DM them for approval. Also tagging @Diego for a one-line technical pull for the blog.

Diego (CS): Here are two tech lines I suggest: 
> "Reduced per-request latency at tail by 40% after switching to Redwood's batching and KV cache optimizations."
> "We consolidated model endpoints into a single dedicated pool, simplifying autoscaling and lowering ops overhead."

ContentBot: Transcript processed and stored: /files/3419998888-nebulagrid-transcript.txt

Asha: Great. Matt, please send the two quote options plus the release PDF to the NebulaGrid marketing contact and ask them to sign/confirm. Ask them to confirm the metric language preference (approx vs exact).

Matt: Sent to marketing@nebulagrid.com. Quick reply from their CMO: "Happy to approve anonymized metrics. We'll sign the release if you can use 'about 2x' and remove the vendor name. Also interested in the webinar but need a draft agenda."

Lina (Legal): Once they reply with signed PDF we can clear the quote. If they insist on naming a vendor, escalate and we need the spreadsheet as backup.

Asha: OK. Diego, can you host the webinar demo? NebulaGrid asked for a short tech deep-dive + Q&A.

Diego (CS): Yes, I can. Prefer 30-40 min with 10-15 min Q&A. Will prepare a short repo + slides.

Matt: CMO attached signed release: https://drive.google.com/file/d/nebulagrid-release.pdf — they chose "about 2x". I copied Lina.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed and countersigned. Approved language: "Redwood lowered inference cost by about 2x while improving reliability." Cleared for use across blog, social, and webinar.

Asha: :white_check_mark: Awesome. Marketing to finalize homepage pull quote and two tweet lines by EOD. Also schedule webinar tentatively for Thu next week — invite list to include product and ops. I'll create the HubSpot tag: case-study/nebulagrid.

Matt: Drafts posted in the doc: 
- Pull quote: "Redwood lowered inference cost by about 2x while improving reliability."
- Tweet 1: "NebulaGrid cut inference spend ~2x with Redwood — faster tail latency & simpler ops."
- Tweet 2: "Shipping new convo features in days, not weeks, after moving to Redwood."

Asha: Nice. Diego  please confirm the speaker bio and slide deck by Monday so we can promote.

Diego (CS): Speaker bio posted in doc. Slides WIP, will push first draft Monday morning.

ContentBot: Assets uploaded: /marketing/assets/nebulagrid-quote-card.png, /marketing/assets/nebulagrid-webinar-slide-v1.pdf

Asha: I'll set the inbound routing: add HubSpot rule tag=case-study/NebulaGrid, owner=Regional SDR team, attach release + transcript. Also draft the webinar RSVP page.

Matt: Added the event to the content calendar and scheduled an internal preview email to Sales for Tue 10am.

Lina (Legal): One note 5: for any customer names used in ad copy, keep them as provided in the release. We're clear here.

Asha: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: signed release in Drive, quote text approved, assets in folder, Diego webinar draft due Mon. I'll close once the RSVP page is live.
